rows.what the ink shows: An ascender and a detached accent survive at the left, but the central letters and the following short word are merged with the heavy horizontal cancellation; the inserted phrase above cannot establish the deleted letters.
The deleted symbol retains the pointed, crossed upper body of A, followed by a smaller E below the baseline at the right.
A triangular capital is followed by low joined e/s strokes and a terminal t rising above the cancellation line.
The q descender, low joined ue and the separate d ascender with apostrophe survive; the following run has a looped ascender but its internal letters are covered by the sloping cancellation.
Three separated remnants show low loops, a short upright and another rising terminal, respectively; the cancellation follows their baseline and conceals the bodies needed to identify the words.
The first letter has a long f stem crossing the baseline and returning upward; the remaining short strokes lie inside two cancellation lines and do not establish orme.
The first sign has two sloping sides and a visible low crossbar, forming A rather than a single upright 1; a separate plus follows it.

An initial tall l and raised apostrophe are visible, with a later crossed t and looped descender compatible with g; several intervening and final letters are obscured by crossing cancellation strokes.
The symbol has two rising stems joined by a broad rounded bottom, followed separately by the closing parenthesis; it is visibly unlike the single upright 1 on the right of the equation.

A looped entry descends below the line, followed by one low arch, a raised dot with a small lower mark, and a long terminal stroke. The dot could belong to i or compressed â; the isolated mark before (2) is too small to establish à.

The deleted span below the inserted au cas is covered almost entirely by a thick horizontal stroke. A short initial slash and a small upward curl near the second word survive, but the component letters are not separable.
A large rounded entry curls into a closed lower loop, followed by a long low exit stroke for the compressed n. The round initial excludes a straight-stemmed opening.

Cancellation covers the first word through its middle, leaving a small loop and a crossed upright. The next word has a long descending p-like stroke and small separated marks, but its interior and ending remain merged with the deletion lines.
An opening parenthesis survives after the small delta. A long descending cancellation slash occupies the expected interior, with no separable A apex or crossbar and no clear closing parenthesis.
The isolated heavy glyph has a rounded bottom joining two upright strokes, with a short outward terminal on the right: a clear lowercase u.

Two baseline A forms occur before the following B; the second A is crossed by a tall cancellation stroke. The raised mark after the first A has a small lower loop and forked top, comparable to the looped star in the right-hand A-star-A on this same line, rather than the open numeral 2 below.
The base letter has two right-hand lobes, a detached left upright, a short lowered stroke at its right, and a separate raised 2. The lobes distinguish B from L.

notes: Actual source dimensions are 1730 by 2223 pixels. All eight assigned marks were inspected; no OCR or text layer was used.

M0601 sent for independent inspection because the raised dot and isolated following mark admit both listed candidates. M0605 may be an unfinished delta-parenthesis; the surviving cancellation does not establish its proposed A.
A small separate loop near x1665,y1290 follows the On-shaped group; its status is not resolved and no unmarked-text correction is asserted.
M0607 initial A^2 decision was corrected after enlarged inspection showed a second baseline A. The initial report and its original finish time are preserved.
M0601 retains uncertainty after the independent check; no discriminating surviving letter joins were established.
M0607 initial A^2 draft was refuted before commit by the primary’s enlarged second-A observation. Original primary draft remains archived.

Independent reader initially retained star/2 uncertainty; direct comparison with forked closed-loop raised glyph and open numeral2 resolved it to A^*A, medium. Accept final primary A^*A; preserve both stages and all actual views/times.
